what: persist-implement-run-flags failure handling only specifies exit 2
scenario_or_breakage: The helper documents validation as exit 2, but set -e failures such as mktemp or mv can exit non-2; the parent script has errexit off, so a non-2 failure could continue without run-flags.sh
suggested_fix: Set run-flags-persist-failed and STALL_TRACKING=true on any non-zero persist rc, not only rc=2
